summary: Nền tảng proxy toàn cầu viết bằng Go, cung cấp hỗ trợ proxy phổ biến với hiệu suất cao và định tuyến linh hoạt.
usecases: Scientific internet access with fine-grained traffic routing.
Local network proxy and DNS manipulation for privacy.
Custom proxy rule implementation for developers.
ideas: Integrate with smart home devices for network-wide ad-blocking.
Combine with headscale for a custom VPN/proxy hybrid solution.
Deploy as a Docker-based exit node for travel security.
